labels.label: bzprop:c3s5p2_support_appui

hypotheses.paper: W un convexe dans un espace vectoriel
hypotheses.note: Convex ℝ W, any real vector space

hypotheses.paper: V une partie convexe non vide de W, I(V, W)
hypotheses.note: V.Nonempty and ProprieteI V W (which contains V ⊆ W and Convex ℝ V)

findings: The first step of the proof (l.1188-1192: for B ∈ L ∩ W some A ∈ V has A α B) needs no topology, no finite-dimensional hull and no property I: with A₀ ∈ V, B − A₀ = r(x − y) with x, y ∈ V, and A = (A₀ + x)/2, ε = 1/(2r+2) give A + ε(A − B) ∈ V. Not a defect of the paper.

labels.label: bzprop:c3s5p3_complementaire_appui

hypotheses.paper: L une variété d'appui de W
hypotheses.note: IsVarieteAppui W L with Convex ℝ W (Déf. 3 and § 5 are about convex W)

hypotheses.paper: C une partie convexe de L ∩ W
hypotheses.note: C ⊆ L ∩ W, Convex ℝ C

questions: Prop. 3 (l.1203) does not repeat that W is convex; it is read from the setting (Déf. 3 of § 1 defines variétés d'appui of a convex W, and § 5 works with convex W). Without convexity the statement fails (W = {−1, 0, 1}, L = {0}; not formalized). « ∁L ∩ W » and « W ∩ ∁L » are read as the same set.

labels.label: bzprop:c3s5p4_propriete_I_appui

hypotheses.paper: V une partie convexe non vide de W convexe
hypotheses.note: all carried in the iff; the ⇐ half (proprieteI_of_isVarieteAppui) needs neither non-emptiness nor a separate V ⊆ W

findings: No proof is printed (l.1221). ⇒ is Prop. 2 plus (L ∩ W) − V = L ∩ (W − V); ⇐ is Prop. 3 with C = (L ∩ W) − V, since W − V = (W − L) ∪ ((L ∩ W) − V). Prop. 1's precise form (imprecise, OQ-162) is not used anywhere.
questions: « le support L de V » read as affineSpan ℝ V, as in Chapter3/Facettes and Appui.

instances: Benzecri.bordCarre_isVarieteAppui (Prop. 2: the support of the edge [0,1]×{0} is a variété d'appui of [0,1]², from proprieteI_segment_carre)
Benzecri.bordCarre_appui_proprieteI (Prop. 4: the right-hand side for the same edge)
